newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SUSTAINABLE PERFORMANCE GROUP STARTS TRADING AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: SUSTAINABLE PERFORMANCE GROUP STARTS TRADING AUG 8.

text.p: Sustainable Performance Group (SPG), a new equity investment company whose founders include Swiss Reinsurance Co, said its shares will start trading on the Swiss stock exchange on Friday, August 8.
Sustainable Performance Group said it had shareholder equity of 88 million Swiss francs following a subscription period between June 17 and July 11.
"The Net Asset Value of the company as of July 31, 1997, was 400.15 Swiss francs," SPG said in a statement.
The issue price was 400 Swiss francs per share plus issuing and placement fees, it said.
SPG is jointly operated by Swiss Re, the Volkart Group and Sustainable Asset Management AG.
It will invest in companies that display an above-average yield/risk profile on the basis of their competitive position, management quality, financial strength and long-term business strategy.
The group said 70 percent of assets were currently invested in 22 companies from 12 countries, with the remaining 30 percent in the money market.

It said 50 percent of the allocation was in two sectors, information technology and chemicals and pharmaceuticals. The other half was split between companies in energy and infrastructure, consumer goods, mobility and finance.
North America accounts for 41 percent of current investment, Europe 36 percent, japan 12 percent, Latin America 10 percent and Asia/pacific one percent,
"In coming weeks further positions will be established by means of additional purchases," it said.
SPG said it would provide quarterly updates on its portfolio and on significant investment decisions. It will also publish Net Asset Value, weekly at first and later on every trading day.
